tags.name: Ai chat sessions
tags.description: Private, tenant- and user-owned Ask AI history, unsent drafts and synchronous model turns. Proposed writes are not executed here.

get.description: Only exposed reviews of this authenticated owner; server-time expiry and sanitized outcome only. No execution or replay.

post.summary: Replace a pending or expired review with its exact validated stored body
post.description: Strict body contains expectedActionId only. Original, expected/latest ID, owner and session must match. Never executes; TTL is five minutes or thirty minutes for landing drafts.

get.summary: Discover the latest turn after a browser reload
get.description: Owner-scoped, reconciled status only. Returns an object with turn=null when no turn exists. Discovers requestId without browser transcript storage and never reruns work.

200.description: Object containing turn: public ChatTurn or null

post.summary: Run an idempotent authenticated conversation turn
post.description: Accepts only requestId (UUID), expectedTranscriptRevision, composerRevision, text and attachments. History is reconstructed on the server. Synchronous execution; matching retries return the running or terminal turn and never replay work. Missing model configuration rejects before claim. Review links become visible only with completed assistant messages.

200.description: Public running or terminal ChatTurn, without lease credentials.

get.summary: Reconnect to an existing turn without rerunning it
get.description: Owner-scoped status only. Expired running turns are interrupted, never resumed. Read messages separately for completed content and reviews.

post.description: Idempotent by requestId for the authenticated owner. Initializes an empty composer and operation row. No model configuration is required.

201.description: Created session, or original session for a retried requestId.

get.description: 30 sessions descending by (updatedAt,id). archived defaults to false. search is a literal, case-insensitive title substring, not a wildcard expression. cursor is canonical base64url JSON [updatedAt,id].

200.description: Session metadata and independent transcript revision.

patch.summary: Rename, archive or restore a session
patch.description: expectedRevision is the metadata revision. Archived sessions accept only explicit restore, without a simultaneous title change. Archive conflicts with active operations and unresolved confirmed actions. Expired unconfirmed operations are fenced and interrupted, never replayed.

200.description: Updated metadata with incremented revision; transcript and composer revisions are unchanged.

delete.summary: Delete an owned session and its content
delete.description: Requires expectedRevision in the query, not the body. Atomically cancels pending reviews and deletes session content. Executed audit records are preserved and links become content-free tombstones. Unresolved confirmed actions or active operations conflict. Capacity limits never block deletion.

get.summary: Read an owned session's message history
get.description: 50 messages per page, fetched descending by sequence and returned chronologically. cursor is canonical base64url JSON [sequence]. Reviews are server-derived, without raw execution results.

put.description: Compare-and-swap using the composer expectedRevision, independent of metadata and transcript revisions. Stores exact text and accepted text attachments. Conflict or quota rejection preserves the previous draft. Archived sessions are read-only. This does not send a message or execute an action.

413.description: Session stored-byte quota exceeded (content_limit). Input validation errors use existing guard conventions.
